incident.message: Unhealthy: Readiness probe failed: wget: download timed out

classification.rationale: Readiness probe timeout with wget indicates a network connectivity or DNS issue preventing the container from reaching another service.

diagnosis.root_cause: The NetworkPolicy 'allow-trusted' in namespace 'lab-04' selects pods with label app=server as the ingress target and permits traffic only from pods matching app=trusted. The client pod carries the label app=client, so no ingress rule matches it and all its traffic to the server is silently dropped, causing the wget readiness probe to time out.

proposal.rationale: The NetworkPolicy 'allow-trusted' currently whitelists ingress to the server only from pods with app=trusted. The client pod's actual label is app=client. Changing the matchLabels value from 'trusted' to 'client' will allow the client pod's traffic through to the server on port 8080, restoring readiness probe success.
proposal.risk: Any pod currently relying on the label app=trusted to reach the server will lose access. Verify no other workloads in lab-04 use that label to reach the server before applying.
proposal.delivery: Apply as a pull request against /gitops after a human approves it. The agent does not change the cluster.

similar_incidents.title: PM-2026-058: NetworkPolicy blocked the billing worker from the ledger service
similar_incidents.fix: Changed spec.ingress[0].from[0].podSelector.matchLabels.app of the server's NetworkPolicy from the old client label to the client's current label, via a GitOps pull request. Clue: client probe timeouts while the server's endpoints are all ready=true.
similar_incidents.excerpt: The label rename on the worker's pod template was reviewed as a cosmetic change; nobody checked which NetworkPolicies selected the old label. With the VPC CNI network policy agent enforcing policies, the packets were dropped silently, so the client saw timeouts, not connection refused. ## Evidence - Client pod events: `Readiness probe failed: wget: download timed out` every 10 s. - `ledger` Endpoi
